_note: Vendors without a price API, transcribed from their own pricing pages with the date read.

vendors.cu_definition: 1 CU = 1 vCPU + 4 GB RAM, so the spec's 2 vCPU / 8 GB is 2 CU
vendors.note: Idle compute suspends and accrues no CU-hours; storage is billed regardless. Suspend delay is 5 minutes on Launch and can be disabled.

excluded.why: Burstable: sustained CPU above a baseline is throttled or billed as credits, so it is not the same product as the fixed-performance instance the spec asks for. Its $94.17 is collected and reported alongside, not substituted in.
